## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: When this story is complete, S1 spike outcomes are documented in the ticket comment thread: (i) the GitHub Actions `branches:` filter targets the PR's BASE branch (confirmed by a minimal test workflow); (ii) the `gh api repos/.../commits/<sha>/pulls` endpoint returns the expected open PR for a live pre-merge session-branch commit (or the 3rd-tier `gh pr list --search 'head:<branch>'` fallback is promoted to tier-1).

## Implementation Notes

**Spike (i) — branches: filter base-ref semantics**: Author a minimal GHA workflow on a throwaway branch with `pull_request: branches: ['session/**']` and trigger by opening a PR FROM a story branch TO a session branch. Confirm the workflow fires (validates that `branches:` filter targets the BASE branch).

**Spike (ii) — SHA-based PR lookup**: For a live commit on a session/** branch (pre-merge), run `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/<sha>/pulls --jq '[.[]|select(.state=="open")] | length'`. Expected: returns 1 (the open PR for that commit). If the endpoint returns 0 for non-default-branch SHAs (per the documented GitHub community discussion), promote the 3rd-tier fallback (`gh pr list --search 'head:<branch>'`) to first-tier in S6's design.

**Output**: Document both spike outcomes as a comment on this task ticket AND on the parent story (a41d-b603-95f1-4b62) using the `.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment` CLI. Body format:

```
SPIKE_OUTCOMES (S1 DoD prerequisite for SC5(a)(ii)):
- Spike (i) branches: filter — RESULT: <fires-on-base | fires-on-head | unexpected>; evidence: <link or copy of GHA run logs>
- Spike (ii) SHA-based PR lookup — RESULT: <returns-PR | returns-empty | unexpected>; promote-tier3: <yes|no>; evidence: <gh api output snippet>
```

## File Impact

No source file modifications. This task produces a documentation artifact (ticket comment).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Spike (i) outcome documented in this task ticket comment
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show a41d-b603-95f1-4b62 2>&1 | grep -q "Spike (i) branches: filter"
- [ ] Spike (ii) outcome documented in this task ticket comment
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show a41d-b603-95f1-4b62 2>&1 | grep -q "Spike (ii) SHA-based PR lookup"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Plan-reviewer audit note
This task has no test task dependency because it produces no behavioral code change (testing_mode: GREEN). Its output is a documentation artifact (ticket comment).
